config.name: Marinara Desktop Win11
config.description: Turns Marinara into a Windows 11 desktop: bottom taskbar (auto-hide), draggable windows, Home as a customizable widget board with desktop icons and bookmarks, small apps (Notes, Web, YouTube), Start menu, Quick Settings, and phone/tablet home screens, per-message token cost receipts, and character counts under messages and the composer. Ctrl+Alt+D switches back to the classic layout.
